tasks.title: Annotation contract and package scaffold
tasks.acceptance: Immutable approved-annotation v1 accepts safe synthetic input and rejects unknown, unsafe, malformed, overlapping, stale, or draft input with stable redacted errors.

tasks.title: Channel-safe native task clips
tasks.acceptance: Canonical clips use the declared channel and sample bounds, preserve native PCM format, expose a separate ASR view, and publish no waveform, transcript, absolute path, participant metadata, or raw exception.

tasks.title: SoX/GSM common-channel profile
tasks.acceptance: Opt-in profile performs the pinned GSM Full Rate round-trip, PCM16 decode, 16 kHz resampling, 200 Hz high-pass, and 3.4 kHz low-pass with deterministic alignment and stable missing-tool errors.

tasks.title: Loudness and DeepFilterNet3 stage
tasks.acceptance: FFmpeg EBU loudnorm and hash-pinned DeepFilterNet3 produce a PCM16 artifact and privacy-safe sidecar; unmeasurable loudness, altered model, clipping, and alignment drift fail closed.

tasks.title: Silero VAD artifact
tasks.acceptance: Silero v6.2.2 CPU ONNX is lazy, hash-checked, and emits bounded half-open integer-sample intervals using explicit defaults and stable failure codes.

tasks.title: `silero_timing` feature pack
tasks.acceptance: Validated preprocessing intervals intersect approved participant turns and emit the specified svad_* metrics/issues without changing native packs or fabricating zeros.

tasks.title: PhoWhisper-medium to `SpeechDocument`
tasks.acceptance: Fake ASR produces valid timed Vietnamese SpeechDocument output; real PhoWhisper-medium configuration is lazy and fails safely when CUDA/model dependencies are unavailable.

tasks.title: Vietnamese word grouping
tasks.acceptance: Underthesea grouping preserves every Vietnamese surface syllable and Unicode distinction, never crosses utterances, and reports localized alignment failures.

tasks.title: Participant-safe JSON and CHAT
tasks.acceptance: Approved speaker turns produce reloadable JSON v2 and optional Chatter-validated CHAT while excluding examiner, ambiguous, and unapproved time.

tasks.title: CLI, provenance, and manifest routing
tasks.acceptance: preprocess and explicit native/processed run routing are atomic and opt-in; manifest v2 remains compatible with optional relative preprocess_path and redacted provenance.

tasks.title: Private A/B evaluator and promotion gate
tasks.acceptance: Synthetic tests prove Vietnamese normalization and aggregate ASR, VAD, timing, DER, format, count, and seeded bootstrap reporting while private data stays untracked.

tasks.title: Private GPU pilot handoff
tasks.acceptance: After CUDA smoke checks succeed, the private PhoWhisper-medium pilot records redacted aggregate quality, runtime, memory, compatibility, and review evidence.
tasks.note: Blocked because nvidia-smi cannot currently communicate with the NVIDIA driver; queue only after nvidia-smi and a PyTorch CUDA smoke pass.
